headline: India Opens the USD 'Tap' to Try to Halt the Rupee's Depreciation
summary: On 10 October the Reserve Bank of India announced measures to ease pressure on the rupee. These include a mechanism to supply US dollars directly to state-owned oil and gas companies, and tighter rules on derivative foreign exchange transactions.
why: The Reserve Bank of India manages the rupee and monetary policy, and India's large oil imports make rupee dollar demand a key pressure point for the currency.
why_moved: The Reserve Bank of India announced new measures aimed at easing pressure on the rupee, including direct dollar supply to state-owned oil and gas firms and tighter derivative FX rules.
